title: CHECKOUT Seedance 2.0 720p (ChatGPT)
prompt_text:
Create a 12-second cinematic teaser for "CHECKOUT," a supernatural prestige thriller — hurricane luxury hotel, sodium emergency lighting, drowned-teal shadows, chrome rain on glass. Pacing: brutal 0.3–0.5s cuts tightening to 0.2s flash-frames at the drop. Needle-drop: low sub-bass pulse, distant generator thrum, one dead-silence beat before title.

[0:00–0:03 — Monitors]
Handheld whip through empty marble lobby, four security monitors flicker — the same pale woman in lobby, pool, corridor, rooftop at once. Hard cut: young concierge breath fogging the glass, reflection wrong by half a beat.

[0:03–0:07 — Evacuation]
Rapid-fire: guests in wet couture sprinting, PA distortion, palm fronds hammering windows. Flash-frames: room key, wristband, elevator indicator, ocean on a floor map that should read 12.

[0:07–0:11 — Flood]
Power snap. Every elevator door slides open to roaring black water instead of a floor. Concierge stares into the shaft — her face duplicated on a monitor behind her, smiling.

[0:11–0:12 — Title]
Vacuum silence. Whisper: "you're still checked in." CHECKOUT slams in chrome serif. Subsonic hit. Black.

Style: Anamorphic 2.39:1, halation on practicals, crushed blacks, magenta-cyan split-tone, Alexa grain. Faces lit from below. No logos. Blackout on final hit.

title: CHECKOUT Sora 2 720p (ChatGPT — web UI)
prompt_text:
12-second supernatural-thriller teaser for CHECKOUT. Luxury coastal hotel in hurricane blackout—Shutter Island meets Severance, filtered through Gen-Z dread. Aesthetic: "Storm Dread"—sodium-gold lobby bleeding into storm-gray hallways, neon security-blue monitor glow, crushing ocean black. Pacing: ruthless. 0.4–0.6s cuts, flashing to 0.15s stutter-frames during the monitor montage. Needle-drop: ominous sub-bass drone, deep storm ambience (wind, creaking metal), fractured dialogue whisper, one dead-silence vacuum before title, then a wet bass-hit impact on the slam.
[0:00–0:03 — Isolation]
Wide: concierge alone at the front desk, hotel lights flickering. Security monitors glow behind him. Hurricane rain hammers floor-to-ceiling windows. One guest walks past the camera—calm, unhurried. Whispered dialogue: "He's still here."
[0:03–0:07 — Recursion]
Rapid hard cuts: same guest on different monitors. Elevator hallway. Penthouse corridor. Stairwell. Security feed glitches—same figure appears twice simultaneously on adjacent screens. Concierge's breathing audible. Storm sound intensifies. One flash-frame: guest's face, distorted, watching the camera.
[0:07–0:11 — Breach]
Slow-mo: elevator doors slide open. Instead of a hallway—black ocean water, calm, bottomless, filling the shaft. Concierge steps back. Whip-pan to the window—the ocean is rising outside the hotel. One frame of his reflection doubled in the glass. Sub-bass drops lower. Silence.
[0:11–0:12 — Title]
Dead silence. Black screen. White sans-serif "CHECKOUT" slams hard center, held for 0.5s, then sub-bass impact + ocean-water splash SFX. Blackout.
Style: Anamorphic 2.39:1, halation on all monitor light sources, crushed blacks on water and storm sky, handheld-verite security-cam jitter on monitors, one slow-mo water breach, handheld camera panic in final acts. All practicals: emergency lighting, monitor glow, lightning flashes. No text except title. No dialogue except the whisper. Costume: modern night-staff black uniform, luxury hotel world cues (marble, brass fixtures, designer seating visible in lobby shots). Audio texture: organic storm, electrical hum, water drip, breathing, sub-bass sub-50Hz rumble throughout. Negative rules: no exposition cards, no explaining the supernatural, no dialogue except the one whisper, no cuts longer than 0.8s except the title hold, blackout on final frame.
